verdict.rationale: ADK supports deploying agents as auto-scaling, always-on services (Agent Runtime, Cloud Run) and provides a Workflow Runtime with loops, retries, state management and multi-agent delegation that can run without human intervention, which supports background/autonomous operation. However, there is no explicit evidence of scheduling, event/cron triggers, or dedicated 'automation' tooling for kicking off agents without a user session. Missing for 10: explicit trigger/scheduling mechanisms, evidence of unattended long-running background jobs, and independent confirmation of autonomous operation in production.
